column3: Create a .NET MAUI App in Visual Studio Insiders for each installed .NET version (.NET10.0, then .NET9.0), verify the generated project's target frameworks, build, debug, and exercise the Click me counter button.

column4: Trigger
Open the Start menu.
Search for Visual Studio Insiders in the Start menu.
Launch the `Visual Studio Insiders` in the Start-menu result.
Wait for the Visual Studio Insiders window to appear.
column16: Visual Studio Insiders window appears (.NET10.0 pass).

column4: Maximize the Visual Studio window so subsequent UIA lookups are stable.
Find the `Create a new project` button on the Start Window.
Click `Create a new project`.
Wait for the `Create a new project` page to appear (same top-level window, content swapped).
In the `Create a new project` window click on the `All languages` (language filter) combo box and make sure `C#` is selected.
Type `.NET MAUI App` into the search box.
Click the search box.
Type `.NET MAUI App` into the search box.
Locate and click the `.NET MAUI App` template item.
Click the `.NET MAUI App` template item.
Find and click the `Next` button to open `Configure your new project`.
Click `Next` to open `Configure your new project`.
In the `Configure your new project` page make sure it is `.NET MAUI App` and click `Next`.
Find the `Next` button on the `Configure your new project` page.
Click `Next` to open `Additional Information`.
In the `Additional Information` window, locate the `Framework` combo box, click the drop down to show all supported frameworks, and remember the items listed.
column16: Framework combo box lists the installed .NET versions.

Click `Create`.
Click `Create`.
